jobs.title: Fullstack Webentwickler
jobs.description:
Stellenbeschreibung  
Als Fullstack Webentwickler bist du die treibende Kraft hinter der Konzeption, Entwicklung und Optimierung moderner Webanwendungen. Du arbeitest an spannenden Projekten, bei denen du sowohl im Frontend als auch im Backend innovative Lösungen umsetzt. Mit deiner Leidenschaft für Technologie gestaltest du benutzerfreundliche Interfaces und sorgst für stabile, skalierbare Systeme. Dabei profitierst du von einem dynamischen Umfeld, das kontinuierliches Lernen fördert und dir die Möglichkeit bietet, deine Fähigkeiten in einem motivierten Team voll auszuschöpfen.

Aufgaben

* Entwicklung und Pflege von responsiven Webanwendungen unter Verwendung moderner Frameworks
* Webflow und Wordpress Kenntnisse von Vorteil
* Gestaltung intuitiver Benutzeroberflächen sowie die Integration von Backend\-Services
* grundlegendes Verständnis von LLMs, APIs und Prompting
* Erfahrung mit API\-Anbindungen und Automatisierungen
* Umsetzung von Datenbanklösungen mit SQL und Optimierung der Datenbankperformance
* Zusammenarbeit in agilen Teams
* Unterstützung bei der Planung, Umsetzung und Dokumentation technischer Anforderungen
* Mitwirkung bei der Einführung neuer Technologien und Best Practices im Entwicklungsprozess

Qualifikationen

* Fundierte Kenntnisse in JavaScript sowie Erfahrung mit Frameworks wie Ruby on Rails oder anderen modernen Webtechnologien
* Erfahrung in serverseitigen Programmiersprachen wie Java, C\# oder Python sowie Kenntnisse in C oder C\+\+ sind von Vorteil
* Vertrautheit mit relationalen Datenbanken und SQL\-Abfragen zur effizienten Datenverwaltung
* Fähigkeit, komplexe technische Herausforderungen transparent zu kommunizieren und im Team lösungsorientiert zu arbeiten
* **Wir bieten dir eine spannende Position in einer wachsenden Agentur. Da du einer der ersten Mitarbeiter bist, sind die Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten sehr gut.**
* Bei uns kannst du deine technischen Fähigkeiten ausbauen, an bedeutenden Projekten mitwirken und gemeinsam mit motivierten Kolleginnen und Kollegen wachsen.
* Du musst nicht alles können. Entscheidend ist, dass du dich selbstständig in neue Technologien einarbeiten kannst und KI gezielt nutzt, um schneller und besser zu entwickeln.

Gehalt: 40\.370,00€ \- 45\.958,48€ pro Jahr

Leistungen:

* Betriebliche Weiterbildung
* Firmenevents
* Firmenfahrrad
* Flexible Arbeitszeiten
* Homeoffice\-Möglichkeit
* Kostenlose Getränke
* Kostenloser Parkplatz

Arbeitsort: Zum Teil im Homeoffice in 70190 Stuttgart

jobs.title: Automation Engineer (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
**About the role**

**As our Automation Engineer, you make sure our software runs reliably in live production environments. You define interfaces, develop robust control architectures and act as the direct point of contact for manufacturers and customers on site.**

**What you will do**

* **Develop and integrate control software**, from architecture through to live operation
* **Connect machines and plant components** via industrial protocols such as OPC UA, Modbus, PROFINET and Ethernet
* **Clarify technical interfaces** directly with machine and plant manufacturers
* **Build reusable middleware and adapter solutions** that are generic and scalable
* **Commission partial and complete systems**, both in house and at customer sites
* **Produce complete plant documentation** as a reliable basis for operation and maintenance

**What you bring**

* Degree or technician qualification in automation technology, mechanical engineering, mechatronics or comparable
* Several years of professional experience in an industrial environment
* Ideally knowledge of C\+\+, Python or C\#, as well as Docker and Docker Compose
* Experience with UML, object oriented programming and communication standards such as PROFINET, Modbus, OPC UA and Ethernet
* Confident with Linux (e.g. Arch Linux, Debian) and Windows 11
* Independent, structured way of working and genuine enjoyment of teamwork
* Willingness to travel occasionally (under 20%)
* Business fluent German and English

**What you can expect from us**

**EVASIVE ROBOTICS is defining the new category in motion planning for industrial robots. Together with leading companies, our agile team works on increasing the productivity of robot installations while keeping complexity manageable. That is how we will set the new standard for what automation can do.**

* Fast growing startup with a highly qualified team. Not a typical 9\-to\-5 job.
* Take ownership of your area from day one and see the direct effect of your work
* Flexible working hours and hybrid work wherever the task allows
* Flat hierarchies, direct communication and a first\-name culture
* Team events, public transport pass and further benefits

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: 50\.000,00€ \- 75\.000,00€ per year

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Dresden, Stadt: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Required)

Education:

* Master's (Required)

Language:

* German (Required)
* English (Required)

Willingness to travel:

* 25% (Required)

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Software & Robotics Engineer (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
**About the role**

As one of our Software \& Robotics Engineers, you are the technical bridge between our motion planning software and real machines and production systems. You take projects from software through to hardware on your own, connect execution logic with real kinematics and sensors, and get our systems running reproducibly.

**What you will do**

* **Run projects end to end**, from software through to the hardware setup
* **Own build and release**, including configuration and commissioning of our systems
* **Dockerise and document deployments** so that every setup stays reproducible
* **Bring software and hardware together** so that execution logic, kinematics, sensor data and control loops work efficiently
* **Test technical workflows and sensor integrations** on the real robot arm before new features and fixes go into the field
* **Keep code quality high** through defined structures, tests, code reviews and CI/CD

**What you bring**

* Confident with C\+\+, C\# and Python
* Routine in build and release processes as well as configuration management
* Proven experience in problem solving and hands\-on troubleshooting on hardware and sensors
* Strong systems thinking
* Knowledge of robot calibration
* Confident presence and the ability to explain technical topics clearly
* High level of ownership and constructive teamwork
* Comfortable with changing areas of responsibility
* English at C1 or above, German at B1 or above

**What you can expect from us**

EVASIVE ROBOTICS is defining the new category in motion planning for industrial robots. jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
For over 100 years, Westfield Health has been on a mission to make a healthy difference to our customers, our colleagues and the communities we work in. What began in Sheffield as a way to help people access affordable healthcare has grown into an international health and wellbeing company, trusted by more than 8,000 businesses and 400,000 people across the UK and Europe. We're proud of our not\-for\-profit roots: with no shareholders, the more successful we are, the more we can give back. We believe healthy people are happier and more productive, so we bring together evidence, insight and genuine care to help people and businesses be at their healthy, productive best, approaching every challenge with curiosity, taking ownership of the outcome, and always putting people first. If that sounds like the kind of place you want to build a career, we'd love to hear from you.

**Software Engineer**
=====================


We're looking for a hands\-on Software Engineer to join our product\-led delivery team, building high\-quality software that delivers great outcomes for Westfield Health and our customers. You'll deliver software that follows the engineering principles set by your Technical Lead, with support from Senior Software Engineers in the team. Our product team works closely with Engineers to define the scope and outcomes for each solution, and you'll play a key role in talking through different approaches and the trade\-offs behind each design.

#### **The Role**

**Location:** Sheffield, UK (Flexible Hybrid)

**Salary:** Up to £45,000\.00 per annum dependent on experience

**Benefits:** Health Cash plan, Private Health Insurance, Pension Scheme, Retail discounts scheme, Annual leave (25 days \+ bank holidays \+ Westfield Day), Corporate Bonus Scheme, Electric Car Scheme, Cycle to Work Scheme, Flexible \& Hybrid working options, Annual Pay Review, On site gym.

**Contract:** Permanent, Full Time (35 hours)

#### **Your responsibilities**

* Build reliable, resilient software solutions, using observability tooling to support running and monitoring in production.
* Deliver new features and changes incrementally, through small, regular deployments.
* Validate new and existing functionality using multiple automated testing approaches.
* Design solutions that deliver measurable value to the business and users, in line with business objectives.
* Propose alternative technical approaches when a solution hits a challenge or obstacle.
* Continuously identify opportunities to improve the technology estate and how change is delivered.
* Communicate complex technical detail clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Support the growth of junior engineers, and challenge peers to strive for excellence and maximise value for customers and the business.

#### **What you’ll bring**

* A proven track record in full\-stack software development, with a strong grasp of a C\#/.NET or TypeScript stack.
* Comfortable working in a cloud\-first environment, using Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
* Skilled in an automation\-first approach, particularly automated testing.
* Well\-versed in DevOps practices and CI/CD tooling.
* Familiar with Agile methodology and planning tools.
* It's a bonus if you've worked with HTTP\-based applications, AngularJS, Next.js, AWS, CDK or Serverless.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with technical and non\-technical stakeholders as part of a product\-led delivery team.
* A proactive approach to problem solving; tackling challenges head\-on and finding solutions that balance multiple priorities.

**Next steps and support:**


If you think you fit the bill, we would love to hear from you!


Our hiring team will review your CV and be in touch with next steps.


Please note, while we welcome global talent, we’re currently unable to sponsor work visas.


We are a proud inclusive and Disability Confident Committed employer, we value inclusivity and want to make sure our application process is open and accessible to all candidates. Please let us know if you require reasonable adjustments to ensure the recruitment process is as comfortable as possible.

jobs.title: Group Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
### **About The Role**


Group Senior Engineer (Electrical)

Reporting to: Group Head of Asset Management


**Drive the future of clean energy. Protect the integrity of our electrical assets. Shape sustainable power across the UK.**



At **enfinium**, we’re on a mission to lead the UK's transition to a zero\-carbon economy by generating reliable, renewable energy from waste. As we continue to grow and innovate, we’re looking for a **Group Senior Engineer (Electrical)** to join our Asset Management team and provide critical electrical engineering leadership across our fleet.



This is a high\-impact role, responsible for ensuring the health, reliability, and future resilience of our electrical infrastructure across all operating assets. If you’re passionate about engineering excellence, grid technology, and sustainability – and you’re ready to make a real difference – we want to hear from you.


**What you'll be doing:**
* Championing electrical engineering best practices across enfinium – acting as our technical authority.
* Leading electrical asset strategy, ensuring optimal reliability, performance, and safety.
* Driving innovation by introducing new technologies and mitigating risk in existing systems.
* Supporting grid connection strategy and ensuring compliance with grid codes and standards.
* Liaising with internal teams and external suppliers to deliver engineering solutions from concept through to operations.
* Leading engineering studies, risk assessments, and root cause analyses.
* Influencing the design and commissioning of new assets, embedding learning and resilience.
* Supporting the development of emerging technologies such as carbon capture and hydrogen systems.

**What we're looking for:**
* A degree (ideally a Master's) in Electrical Engineering or equivalent NVQ Level 7\.
* Chartered status with a recognised professional engineering body.
* Proven experience as a senior electrical engineer – ideally in the power generation or energy\-from\-waste sector.
* Deep understanding of electrical power systems, public grid connections, and transmission infrastructure.
* Demonstrable experience across the full project lifecycle – from feasibility to operations.
* Strong leadership, communication, and stakeholder engagement skills.
* A collaborative, forward\-thinking mindset with a passion for sustainability and innovation.

### **About Us**


**Who are enfinium?**



As one of the UK’s leading energy from waste operators, enfinium is supporting our country’s journey to a Net Zero economy. We do this by operating and developing six decarbonisation hubs around the UK, where we use waste that would otherwise go to landfill to generate homegrown energy.



Today, enfinium has an annual waste processing capacity of over 2\.3 million tonnes, and a total combined electric generating capacity of 265MW (gross) \- enough energy to power more than 500,000 UK homes. enfinium is owned by infrastructure investment funds managed by Igneo Infrastructure Partners



At enfinium we’re guided by five principles, we use these to make sure we’re not only doing a great job, but we’re doing it in the right and safe way:


**One Team \- Pride Matters \- Safety on Purpose \- Make a positive impact \- Take Ownership**



As a Company, we really value our employees and as such, offer a generous employee benefits package which includes the following:


* Vitality Private Medical care
* Private Dental Care
* Life Assurance
* Company pension with a 6% company contribution
* Perkbox to get all your Highstreet discounts
* Cycle to Work scheme
* Employee Assistance programme
* Uniform provided
* Continuous learning and development through our e\-learning portal and access to role\-based qualifications

jobs.title: Application Engineering Senior Developer - .NET Full Stack & Integrations
jobs.description:
Location: Wrocław
Other locations: Primary Location Only
Salary: Competitive
Date: 11 Sept 2026
**Job description**
-------------------


Requisition ID: 1741327
**Application Engineering Senior Developer \- .NET Full Stack \& Integrations**

  



Location: Wrocław \- 2 days in office / 3 days remote

  



Let us introduce you the job offer by EY GDS Poland – a member of the global integrated service delivery center network by EY.

  


**The opportunity**

  



The Application Engineering Lead is responsible for designing, building, and owning complex full stack applications and enterprise integrations. This role requires deep technical expertise across .NET, API integrations, databases, and data pipelines, along with strong ownership of production systems, migration activities, and critical cutovers. The role operates with minimal supervision and serves as a key technical decision maker and escalation point.

  


**Your key responsibilities**

  



Application Development \& Integrations:


* Lead the design and implementation of API integrations using REST, JSON, and industry standard authentication mechanisms (OAuth2, JWT, API keys, etc.).
* Lead the design and Implementation of Front end applications using Angular/HTML/Typescript
* Build and maintain robust, secure, and scalable integrations with structured error handling, logging, and retry mechanisms.
* Design and implement reverse and batch integrations across internal and external systems.
* Act as the technical authority for complex integration patterns, data flows, and migration solutions.

  



Database \& Data Engineering:


* Design and develop SQL Server solutions, including complex queries, stored procedures, performance tuning, and indexing strategies.
* Perform production data fixes with strong governance, validation, and audit controls.
* Implement and manage ETL and data pipelines using Azure Data Factory (ADF) and/or SSIS.
* Handle large scale, high volume data processing, ensuring data accuracy, reconciliation, and integrity across systems.

  



Production Ownership \& Reliability:


* Own end to end accountability for critical production systems and integrations.
* Lead production issue triage, root cause analysis, and remediation, maintaining composure and sound judgment during high severity incidents.
* Serve as a trusted escalation point during production issues, migration waves, and release cutovers.
* Ensure system stability, observability, and operational readiness across environments.

  



Leadership \& Stakeholder Management:


* Operate independently with minimal guidance, making informed technical and delivery decisions.
* Act as a subject matter expert (SME) for integration and migration initiatives.
* Collaborate effectively with business stakeholders, architects, and delivery teams to translate requirements into technical solutions.
* Coordinate across multiple teams during migrations and production cutovers, ensuring aligned execution and clear communication.
* Mentor and guide engineers on integration patterns, coding standards, and operational best practices.

  



Supervision Responsibilities:


* Direct reports
* Working relationships (daily) with EY ITSD and AMS Lead
* Working relationships (daily) with TCS AMS team
* Liaison to the Business for that Portfolio / App

  


**Skills and attributes for success**

  



Frontend \& UI Engineering (Angular):


* Strong hands on experience with Angular (version 20\+) for enterprise grade web applications.
* Expertise in TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3, and modern JavaScript (ES6\+).
* Experience designing and implementing component based architectures, reusable modules, and shared UI libraries.
* Strong understanding of Angular lifecycle hooks, dependency injection, routing, and state management.
* Experience with RxJS and reactive programming, including observables, subjects, and subscription management.
* Ability to consume and integrate REST APIs into Angular applications with proper error handling and retry logic.
* Experience implementing authentication and authorization mechanisms on the UI (token handling, role based access, guards).
* Proficiency in frontend performance optimization, change detection strategies, and lazy loading.
* Familiarity with responsive design and enterprise UI standards.
* Experience troubleshooting and resolving production UI issues with minimal supervision.

  



Core Technology Stack:


* Strong hands on experience with .NET / .NET Core, C\#, and full stack application development.
* Extensive experience with RESTful API design and integration, including:
* JSON payloads and schema validation
* Authentication and authorization mechanisms
* Structured error handling and resiliency patterns

  



Databases \& Data Processing:


* Advanced expertise in SQL Server, including:
* Complex query design
* Stored procedures and performance optimization
* Controlled production data fixes
* Strong understanding of data reconciliation, validation, and high volume data handling.

  



ETL \& Integration Platforms:


* Hands on experience with Azure Data Factory (ADF) and/or SSIS.
* Knowledge of batch processing, scheduling, and dependency management.
* Experience designing scalable data pipelines for enterprise integrations.

  


**To qualify for the role, you must have**

  



Experience:


* 6\+ years of experience in application engineering / full stack development, with significant exposure to enterprise integrations.
* Prior experience in lead or senior technical roles with ownership of production systems.
* Experience supporting large migrations, platform transitions, or enterprise cutovers is highly desirable.

  


**What we offer**

  



EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across nine locations – Argentina, Hungary, India, the Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well\-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever\-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.

  


* **Continuous learning**: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* **Success as defined by you**: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* **Transformative leadership**: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* **Diverse and inclusive culture:** You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

  


**About EY**


**EY \| Building a better working world**

  



EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.



Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.



Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

  


**If you can demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible.**


**The exceptional EY experience. It’s yours to build.**

  



In compliance with the requirements of the Whistleblower Protection Act, our company has established the *Procedure for reporting breaches of law and undertaking appropriate follow\-up actions*. Any misconduct should be reported through the EY Ethics Hotline.

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description:
**Role**  

We're looking for a senior AI Engineer for a consulting assignment focused on building AI\-driven capabilities in a business\-critical, quality\-sensitive setting for a company within healthcare/medtech.

**Responsibilities**

* Build AI functions that turn clinical content into practical, actionable suggestions for therapists in their daily work.
* Design end\-to\-end pipelines, including prompt and chain architectures, with structured outputs broken into clear, independently testable steps.
* Own model selection and strategy, including fine\-tuning open\-weight models.
* Help establish a data foundation with measurable quality, ensuring data is de\-identified, version\-controlled, and reproducible.
* Define per\-function evaluation methodology — identifying which error types matter most and what quality bar must be met before output reaches a human reviewer.
* Set up regression testing and continuous quality monitoring in production.
* Build traceability mechanisms capturing what the AI suggests versus what the reviewer approves or edits, supporting transparency and long\-term improvement.

**Required Skills**

* Proven experience building LLM\-based systems that run in production, not just proof\-of\-concept work.
* Able to give concrete examples of how you've iterated on and improved live solutions over time.
* Strong background across data modeling, pipeline development, and model\-related engineering.
* Clear understanding of why versioning datasets matters as much as versioning code.
* Experience handling sensitive personal data, with a real grasp of how nuanced de\-identification can be.
* Comfortable working against defined quality bars rather than optimizing for a demo.
* Understands the stakes of reliability in AI systems, particularly where mistakes carry real consequences.
* Consulting mindset: able to step into an existing team, collaborate closely with domain experts, and leave behind solutions others can maintain.

**Nice to Have**

* Background in medical technology, healthcare, or other regulated fields with strong traceability requirements.
* Experience with speech\-to\-text systems, particularly for Swedish as a lower\-resource language.
* Familiarity with the .NET ecosystem.

jobs.description:
Job Description
  
  

**Internship:** Project Engineering \- Digital Engineering Manufacturing
  
**Location:** Carlow
  
**Duration:** 6 months or longer
  
  

Join a team that is transforming how manufacturing and engineering teams use data, automation, digital tools, and problem\-solving to improve performance across a world\-class biopharmaceutical manufacturing site. As an Intern within our Engineering and Manufacturing organisation, you will work alongside engineers, automation specialists, and operations teams to deliver projects that create measurable improvements in safety, quality, productivity, and user experience.
  
  

This role is ideal for students studying Engineering, Automation, Mechatronics, Computer Science, Manufacturing Technology, Data Analytics, or related disciplines who are looking for hands\-on industry experience and the opportunity to identify and develop a final\-year project with real business impact.
  
  

Responsibilities
  
  

* Support engineering, automation, and manufacturing teams in the execution of process improvement and digital transformation initiatives.
* Develop dashboards, reports, and visual management tools that improve visibility of operational performance, actions, and business metrics.
* Apply structured problem\-solving techniques to investigate recurring issues and identify sustainable improvements.
* Analyse operational and engineering data to identify trends, opportunities, and performance improvements.
* Support implementation of connected worker technologies, workflow digitisation, and manufacturing excellence initiatives.
* Contribute ideas that make engineering spaces more engaging, connected, and human while maintaining the standards expected within a regulated industry.
* Participate in cross\-functional projects involving manufacturing, engineering, automation, quality, maintenance, and continuous improvement teams.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, user guides, standard work, and process maps.
* Help create solutions that people talk about, remember, and proudly show to others because they are both useful and well designed
* Own an individual improvement project with defined deliverables and present outcomes to site leadership at the conclusion of the placement.


Qualifications
  
  

* Currently completing 2nd, 3rd, or 4th year of a Degree or Masters programme where an internship or work placement forms part of the course requirements.
* Studying Engineering, Mechatronics, Automation, Computer Science, Software Development, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Data Analytics, or a related STE(A)M discipline.
* Demonstrated interest in technology, digitalisation, automation, data analysis, or problem solving.
* Strong analytical thinking and attention to detail.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
* Ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a team environment.
* Curiosity, initiative, and a willingness to learn from experienced professionals.


Preferred
  
  

* Knowledge with programming, scripting, automation, or data analysis tools.
* Knowledge with Power Platform, Power BI, Python, SQL, C\#, JavaScript, PLC programming, or similar technologies.
* Participation in university projects, competitions, societies, robotics teams, hackathons, or maker activities.
* An interest in applying engineering and technology solutions within advanced manufacturing environments.
* An appreciation for thoughtful design and the confidence to challenge conventional approaches where a better solution exists.
* A curiosity for how technology, automation, and design can come together to create solutions that people genuinely want to use.


Additional Work\-Life Information
  
  

* Typical expectation is to be present onsite in Carlow Monday to Friday 0900hrs to 1700hrs with performance\-based remote working opportunities.
* Flexibility with respect to commuting challenges.


Throughout the placement, you will have the opportunity to build technical expertise, develop professional skills, expand your network, and contribute to projects that deliver meaningful business impact while improving outcomes for patients worldwide.

new_jobs.title: Automation Engineer (m/f/d)
new_jobs.description:
**About the role**

**As our Automation Engineer, you make sure our software runs reliably in live production environments. You define interfaces, develop robust control architectures and act as the direct point of contact for manufacturers and customers on site.**

**What you will do**

* **Develop and integrate control software**, from architecture through to live operation
* **Connect machines and plant components** via industrial protocols such as OPC UA, Modbus, PROFINET and Ethernet
* **Clarify technical interfaces** directly with machine and plant manufacturers
* **Build reusable middleware and adapter solutions** that are generic and scalable
* **Commission partial and complete systems**, both in house and at customer sites
* **Produce complete plant documentation** as a reliable basis for operation and maintenance

**What you bring**

* Degree or technician qualification in automation technology, mechanical engineering, mechatronics or comparable
* Several years of professional experience in an industrial environment
* Ideally knowledge of C\+\+, Python or C\#, as well as Docker and Docker Compose
* Experience with UML, object oriented programming and communication standards such as PROFINET, Modbus, OPC UA and Ethernet
* Confident with Linux (e.g. Arch Linux, Debian) and Windows 11
* Independent, structured way of working and genuine enjoyment of teamwork
* Willingness to travel occasionally (under 20%)
* Business fluent German and English

**What you can expect from us**

**EVASIVE ROBOTICS is defining the new category in motion planning for industrial robots. Together with leading companies, our agile team works on increasing the productivity of robot installations while keeping complexity manageable. That is how we will set the new standard for what automation can do.**

* Fast growing startup with a highly qualified team. Not a typical 9\-to\-5 job.

* Flexible working hours and hybrid work wherever the task allows

new_jobs.title: Software & Robotics Engineer (m/f/d)
new_jobs.description:
**About the role**

As one of our Software \& Robotics Engineers, you are the technical bridge between our motion planning software and real machines and production systems. You take projects from software through to hardware on your own, connect execution logic with real kinematics and sensors, and get our systems running reproducibly.

**What you will do**

* **Run projects end to end**, from software through to the hardware setup
* **Own build and release**, including configuration and commissioning of our systems
* **Dockerise and document deployments** so that every setup stays reproducible
* **Bring software and hardware together** so that execution logic, kinematics, sensor data and control loops work efficiently
* **Test technical workflows and sensor integrations** on the real robot arm before new features and fixes go into the field
* **Keep code quality high** through defined structures, tests, code reviews and CI/CD

**What you bring**

* Confident with C\+\+, C\# and Python
* Routine in build and release processes as well as configuration management
* Proven experience in problem solving and hands\-on troubleshooting on hardware and sensors
* Strong systems thinking
* Knowledge of robot calibration
* Confident presence and the ability to explain technical topics clearly
* High level of ownership and constructive teamwork
* Comfortable with changing areas of responsibility
* English at C1 or above, German at B1 or above

**What you can expect from us**

new_jobs.description:
### **About the Role**



We're hiring a Senior .NET / Angular Programmer to design and develop enterprise web applications using Angular on the front end and .NET on the back end. You'll lead UI/UX implementation, ensure responsive design and performance, and integrate with secure back\-end services.



### **Key Responsibilities**



* Design scalable web applications using Angular and .NET Core



* Develop Angular components, routing, and state management



* Build .NET APIs and database layers using EF Core



* Ensure front\-end performance, responsive design, and accessibility



* Apply advanced Angular practices (lazy loading, interceptors, RxJS)



* Integrate with secure back\-end APIs and authentication mechanisms



* Establish testing, CI/CD pipelines, and code reviews



* Collaborate with designers on localization (Arabic/English)



* Prepare documentation and deployment scripts



* Optimize performance and recommend improvements



* Perform other related tasks as assigned



### **Required Qualifications**



* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent



* Minimum 5 years of experience with Angular (v10\+) and .NET Core



* Strong hands\-on skills: Angular (RxJS, NgRx, Material), .NET Core, REST/JSON, SQL, Git, CI/CD, responsive design



### **Preferred Qualifications**



* Microsoft or Angular certification



* Prior experience delivering projects for government or public\-sector clients in the Middle East



* Fluency in Arabic and English

**About Four Seasons:**


Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Our team members around the world create amazing experiences for our guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury with genuine heart. We know that the best way to enable our people to deliver these exceptional guest experiences is through a world\-class employee experience and company culture.
  

  

At Four Seasons, we believe in recognizing a familiar face, welcoming a new one and treating everyone we meet the way we would want to be treated ourselves. Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us.

**About the location:**


An architectural icon in the heart of Saudi Arabia’s vibrant capital soaring over the city in the iconic Kingdom Tower, Four Seasons Hotel Riyadh is a buzzing hub at the forefront of style and sophistication. Redesigned interiors bring authentic Saudi heritage and craftsmanship to life, while our distinguished team provides a bespoke experience through thoughtful, personalized service and hospitality.**The Role of the Shift Engineer**

As a shift engineer, your role in providing machinist work to all equipment is crucial in maintaining the seamless operation of Four Seasons Hotels. With your expertise, you ensure the smooth functioning of essential components such as bearings, gears, belts, shafts, and control mechanisms.


Your professionalism plays a significant role in upholding the high standards that Four Seasons Hotels are known for. A professional demeanour not only reflects positively on your own abilities but also contributes to creating a positive and welcoming environment for guests.


By consistently demonstrating your technical skills and conducting yourself professionally, you contribute to the overall guest experience at Four Seasons Hotels. Your attention to detail and commitment to excellence make you an invaluable asset in ensuring that all equipment runs efficiently and flawlessly.

**Four Seasons Hotel Riyadh**

Prime location in the heart of the capital, nestled within the iconic 99\-storey Kingdom Tower. Situated at such a prestigious address, our property offers unparalleled proximity to key business areas, shopping centres, and cultural sites, 276 spacious and light\-filled rooms, including 39 luxurious suites.


Area of responsibility is Engineering.

**Food \& Beverage**

The hotel offers three exceptional restaurant venues, collectively offering a seating capacity of 250 guests.


Our event facilities, with a mix of Ballroom and Meeting Rooms offer a remarkable 7,213 square meters (77,640 square feet) of space, making them the perfect choice for a wide range of events.

**SPA and Wellness**


Nestled within our establishment, our world\-class spa offers an array of indulgence across 8 treatment rooms for male guests and 1 treatment room designed exclusively for female guests. This haven of rejuvenation also encompasses high end facilities and a meticulously outfitted fitness center.

**Knowledge and Skills**

* Diploma or bachelor’s degree relevant to the role not less than 4 years.
* Four years technical training and field experience as a machinist or operations engineer
* Saudi Council of engineers certificate.
* Reading, writing, and oral proficiency in the English language
* Background with laundry, HVAC, kitchen equipment and electrical
* Must have basic computer skills of Microsoft office and word.
* Must have good communications skills to coordinate with daily follow\-up emails.
